name: BBOX burns 3% of each trade from its pair on the next ordinary transfer
summary: BBOX adds 3% of every buy and sell to pairAmount and, on the next transfer not sent by the pair, moves pairAmount out of the BBOX/WBNB pair's balance to the zero address and syncs. With 3,043 flash-loaned WBNB the attacker bought BBOX into a helper for 1,302 WBNB, so pairAmount reached 3% of that buy; the helper's transfer back burned it from the pair, and the attacker sold into the shrunken BBOX reserve for 1,340 WBNB.
notes: Owner changes after deployment only lowered addLiquidityValue (slot 0x26) and the LP-reward period (slot 0x19); the pairAmount burn and pairAmountChange are unchanged since deployment, so the deployment is the reset.

Campaign: every net WBNB outflow above 5 WBNB from the BBOX/WBNB pair since its creation; before the anchor the largest were ordinary router sells (up to 41 WBNB, an EOA's dump at block 17130372), and none followed it. Loss is the pair's net WBNB outflow; its BBOX is valued at nothing (rule 12).
